items.evidence: All eight labware loaded with the specified load names, slots and labels; p20 left and p300 right with tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Master mix 106/40/4/2 µL, then 19 µL mix, 2.5 µL fwd/rev primers and 1 µL template (A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1) per well; end-state checks pass.
Steps 12–15 add 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart and 1 µL DpnI, then mix; the 37/65 °C incubation and Zymo clean-up are recorded in comments with a pause, in the right order.
Assembly wells get 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3/2/3 µL backbone fragments 2/5/6, 2 µL chromoprotein fragments 1/3/4/7 and 1 µL enzyme mix, matching the task.
Comment records 30 cycles of 37 °C 5 min and 16 °C 5 min, then 60 °C 5 min, hold at 4 °C, lid about 85 °C.
The assembly clean-up is recorded with a pause, then 5 µL goes to cells A1:D1 and 250 µL LB+dextrose is added to each; the ice, heat-shock and recovery comments are present.
A new tip is used per well for primers, templates and enzymes; the no_cross_contamination check passes. Shared tips are used only for same-reagent distributions, as in the reference.

p20 handles all volumes of 20 µL or less and p300 the larger ones (106 split into 2×53, 40, 250, mixes of 100 and 30 µL). Pauses are placed at the manual steps, and the tip, empty-well and overdispense checks pass.
Follows the 33 steps in order with accurate comments; the only deviations are a harmless extra pause after the PCR and a 'C1000' typo for the thermocycler model.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all quantities and step order, uses the correct labware, labels and pipettes, and passes every measured check. Its only blemishes are a harmless extra pause and a minor thermocycler model typo in a comment.
